request.style: English, solo female voice, mournful, celtic harp, bodhran, low strings, flute, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In spring the kings march out to war
David stayed in Jerusalem
He walked the roof of the king's house
Saw a woman bathing there
She was Bathsheba daughter of Eliam
Wife of Uriah the Hittite
David sent messengers for her
And slept with her that night

[Chorus]
You are the man Nathan said
As the Lord lives the man must die
Repays four times for the little ewe
Who had no pity in his eye

[Verse]
David sent word to Joab
Send me Uriah the Hittite
Uriah slept at the gate of the house
He did not go to his own door
David wrote a letter in the morning
Put him where the fighting is fiercest
Pull back so he is struck down
Joab obeyed the king's command

[Chorus]
You are the man Nathan said
As the Lord lives the man must die
Repays four times for the little ewe
Who had no pity in his eye

[Verse]
Bathsheba heard her husband died
She mourned for him in grief
When the mourning was over
David sent for her again
She became his wife and bore a son
But the child did not live
Nathan spoke of disaster rising
From within the king's own house

[Chorus]
You are the man Nathan said
As the Lord lives the man must die
Repays four times for the little ewe
Who had no pity in his eye

[Bridge]
The sword will never depart
From your house because you despised me
I gave you your master's house
And if it was too little I would add more

[Outro]
You are the man Nathan said
You are the man
